verses.en: For this cause I Paul, the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles,
verses.sm: Paulo o le ua noanoatia ona o Keriso Iesu, ona o outou o nuu ese;

verses.en: If ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me to you-ward:
verses.sm: aua ua outou faalogologo ua fai au ma auauna tausi mea i le alofa tunoa o le Atua ua tuuina mai ja te au mo outou;

verses.en: How that by revelation he made known unto me the mystery; (as I wrote afore in few words,
verses.sm: ina ua na faailoa mai ia te au i le faaaliga, o le mea lilo, faapei ona aʻu muai tusia i ni upu itiiti;

verses.en: Whereby, when ye read, ye may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ)
verses.sm: pe a faitaulia e mafai ai outou ona iloa ai Ic“ loto matala i le mea lilo e uiga ia Keriso,

verses.en: Which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men, as it is now revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit;
verses.sm: § sa le faailoa atu i nisi tupulaga o le fanauga a tagata, faapei ona faaali mai nei e le Agaga, i ana aposetolo paia, ma ana perofeta;

verses.en: That the Gentiles should be fellowheirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in Christ by the gospel:
verses.sm: ia avea nuu ese ma suli faatasi ma tino e tasi, ma ia tofusia faatasi i lana sa folafola mai ona o Keriso Iesu i le tala lelei.

verses.en: Whereof I was made a minister, according to the gift of the grace of God given unto me by the effectual working of his power.
verses.sm: Ua fai aʻu ma auauna a lena tala lelei e tusa ma le mea foaifuaina mai i le alofa tunoa o le Atua, ua na foaiina mai ia te au i le galuega tele a lona mana.

verses.en: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;
verses.sm: Ua au mai ia te au, le aupito itiiti lava i le au paia uma, lenei lava alofa tunoa, ina ia ou folafola atu i nuu ese le oloa faulai o Keriso e le masuesueina lava;

verses.en: And to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery, which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God, who created all things by Jesus Christ:
verses.sm: e faamalamalamaina atu foi i tagata uma le uiga o le sauniuniga o le mea lilo sa natia talu mai i tupulaga anamua i le Atua, o le na faia mea uma lava;

verses.en: To the intent that now unto the principalities and powers in heavenly places might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God,
verses.sm: ina ia iloa nei e alii sili ma le au faipule i :mea o i le lagi, i le ekalesia, le poto uiga eseese o le Atua.

verses.en: According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord:
verses.sm: Ua tusa lea ma lona finagalo talu anamua lava, na ia faia ia Keriso Iesu lo tatou Alii;

verses.en: In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him.
verses.sm: o ia ua tatou maua ai le faamalosi, ma le ala e sao atu ai ma le loto tele, i le faatuatua ia te ia.

verses.en: Wherefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you, which is your glory.
verses.sm: O lenei, ou te aioi atu, aua neʻi faavaivai ina ua puapuazatia aʻu ona o outou, aua o le mea tou te mitamita ai lena.

verses.en: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.sm: O le mea lea ou te tootuli ai i le Tamā,

verses.en: Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named,
verses.sm: o ia ua faaigoaina ai le aiga umaoilelagi atoa male lalolagi;

verses.en: That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man;
verses.sm: ina ia foaiina ia te outou E tusa ma le faulai o lona mamalu, ia faamalosia outou i le mana e lona lava Agaga i le tagata i totonu,

verses.en: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,
verses.sm: ia nofo mau foi o Keriso i o outou loto i le faatuatua; ina ia mauaa ma faavaeina outou i le alofa,

verses.en: May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth, and length, and depth, and height;
verses.sm: ia mafai ai ona iloa lelei e outou atoa ma le au paia uma, o le uiga o le lautele, ma le umi, ma le loloto, ma le maualuga,

verses.en: And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God.
verses.sm: ia iloa foi le alofa o Keriso ua silisili ese e le mailoa, ia faatutumuina outou i le tumu uma lava o le Atua.

verses.en: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,
verses.sm: O lenei, ia ia te ia o le na te mafaia ona faia o mea uma e faasilisili lava i mea tatou te ole atu ai ma mafaufau i ai, e tusa ma le mana o loo matuà galue i totonu ia te i tatou,

verses.en: Unto him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.
verses.sm: ia ia te ia le viiga i le ekalesia ma Keriso Iesu, i augatupulaga uma, e faavavau faavauvau lava.
